name: Alloy Cognitive Agentic Blueprint
description: Alloy Meridian — Cognitive agentic layer blueprint for governed multi-agent orchestration across the SZL Holdings ecosystem

layers.name: Perception Layer
layers.description: Ingests signals from all domain systems, normalizes them into a unified event schema, and routes to the reasoning layer

layers.name: Reasoning Layer
layers.description: Applies cognitive patterns — chain-of-thought, plan-and-execute, multi-agent debate — to evaluate signals and generate candidate actions

layers.name: Decision Layer
layers.description: Evaluates candidate actions against policy rules, routes to appropriate approval class, and maintains a full decision ledger

layers.name: Execution Layer
layers.description: Safely executes approved actions through registered skill handlers, connectors, and workflow engines

layers.name: Observation Layer
layers.description: Monitors execution outcomes, feeds results back into the perception layer, and generates performance telemetry

auto.description: Executes immediately without human approval. Low-risk read operations and pre-authorized writes.

review.description: Queued for async human review. Moderate-risk actions that change state.

admin_only.description: Requires admin or super_admin role approval before execution. High-risk or irreversible actions.

cognitivePatterns.name: Governed Chain-of-Thought
cognitivePatterns.description: Transparent reasoning chain logged to the audit ledger at each step. Allows human reviewers to inspect the decision path.
cognitivePatterns.useCase: Complex multi-step decisions requiring audit trail

cognitivePatterns.name: Plan-and-Execute
cognitivePatterns.description: Decomposes a high-level goal into atomic sub-tasks, executes them in dependency order, and synthesizes results.
cognitivePatterns.useCase: Multi-domain workflows like incident triage and release prep

cognitivePatterns.name: Multi-Agent Debate
cognitivePatterns.description: Spawns multiple specialized agents with competing perspectives, runs structured debate, and synthesizes consensus position.

cognitivePatterns.name: Reflexion Loop
cognitivePatterns.description: Agent evaluates its own output against success criteria, iterates up to N times, and escalates if convergence fails.
cognitivePatterns.useCase: Code generation, report drafting, and data validation

skillRegistry.description: Central registry of all Alloy skills with metadata for routing and approval

mcpIntegration.securityModel: JWT-authenticated HTTP endpoint; stdio server inherits shell permissions

deploymentTargets.description: Primary deployment target. Express API server scales to zero between requests.
Zero-dependency MCP server that runs as a Codex plugin for in-editor tool access.
